why_it_fails: Stage = website discovery / menu resolution. locators.py CONNECTORS maps ^verilife\b to https://risecannabis.com/dispensaries/illinois/ (line ~24). Plain GET of that host is a Cloudflare 403, so _known_menu_candidates returns status failed (Locator HTTP 403) or relies on the browser render of a JS listing; the pipeline then falls through to search_websites (Bing/DDG fallback, dead per coordinator) and only gets the verilife.com home as a lead. Even when a Rise branch landing page is reached, its JSON-LD streetAddress is 'N Weber Rd 412' (street_one + street_two swapped), so site_discovery.inspect_page reports identity conflict, and RISE_MENU/hosted_store (jane.py) only matches URLs that already contain the numeric Jane id, which the landing page URL does not. The Jane reader itself would pass: platform pin is 0.01 mi from the registry point.
fix_idea: Chain-level, helps all Rise/Verilife/Bloom/Cannabist-style GTI stores (about 29 IL branches in the Rise directory): (1) add a Rise directory reader: via the browser, call /api/opensearch/dispensaries/nearest (limit 25, paged by lat/lon over IL) and read address (street_two is the house number), coordinates and menuDetails slugs; feed the numeric menu URLs straight into the existing Rise-hosted Jane path (hosted_store). (2) For Verilife specifically, point the ^verilife connector at https://www.verilife.com/locations (plain-fetchable, exact street text), follow its il/menu/<slug>-recreational|medical links but capture the 301 Location header instead of fetching the Cloudflare-challenged target, and pass that URL to hosted_store. (3) Normalize the swapped JSON-LD streetAddress in inspect_page (move a trailing house number to the front) so branch landing pages stop reading as identity conflicts.
